Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Kobayakawa Hideaki, matching the attached character sheet exactly.
Subject: Preserve his youthful face, dark teal and green armor, gold-edged helmet with paired upward horns, and subtle purple accent associated with his yokai blade. Frame the entire horn tips, face, shoulders, and upper chest.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, refined armor detail, dramatic restrained lighting; keep the face readable.
Composition/framing: One person, centered bust with visible flat-magenta margin on every edge.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Match the reference identity and costume. The sword is a yokai blade, but omit it if it does not fit a head-and-shoulders portrait.
Avoid: Text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped horns or shoulders, gradients, background shadow, watermark.
